researchQuestion: When is multiplication of independently produced game-level probabilities sufficiently accurate for an explicitly labeled AISP research display?

admittedPopulations.chronologyQualification: Season-forward fold prediction; physical per-game forecast publication time is not established.
Season-forward Development prediction; historical source publication vintages are uncertified.

admittedPopulations.rowFilter: role == development and season in 2016..2022 and context_eligible and is_final
admittedPopulations.chronologyQualification: Features and fits use earlier games; historical source publication vintages are uncertified.

excludedPopulations: All MLB Final OOT, sealed August 14-27 2026 data, and permanently quarantined games
NFL Final OOT 2025 and current 2026 outcomes
NBA reused Validation, inspected holdouts, 2024-25 and 2025-26 assessment outcomes
CFB Validation 2023-24, historical holdout 2025, and prospective 2026 outcomes
Any target lacking a chronological out-of-fold or season-forward forecast

pairConstruction.slateDefinition: sport plus recorded game calendar date for same-sport; calendar date for cross-sport
pairConstruction.withinSlatePairing: all unique unordered game pairs; canonical game identity sort; no reverse duplicates
pairConstruction.crossSportPairing: all game combinations between two sports on a shared calendar date
pairConstruction.primaryEligibility: distinct games, no shared team, regular season, unique exact forecast row
pairConstruction.sharedTeamAndPostseason: count and report separately; excluded from permissible category
pairConstruction.sameStartWindow: absolute scheduled-start difference <= 60 minutes where both exact times exist
pairConstruction.separatedStart: absolute scheduled-start difference > 180 minutes where both exact times exist
pairConstruction.unclassifiedTiming: at least one source supplies date only
pairConstruction.jointEvent: HOME_WIN in each game using the pre-outcome home-win probability
pairConstruction.favoriteClass: HOME leg is FAVORITE when pHome >= 0.5, otherwise UNDERDOG
pairConstruction.modelFavoriteSupplement: predeclared supplemental pair using max(pHome,pAway); not selected after outcomes
pairConstruction.totalsJointCalibration: unsupported unless a retained per-game pre-outcome total probability exists; point expectations alone are insufficient

estimands.uncertainty: 2000 deterministic percentile resamples of whole date/slate clusters; seed 20260916
estimands.effectiveSampleSize: number of distinct date/slate clusters, reported with games and pairs
estimands.multipleComparisons: Holm adjustment within the family of residual-correlation tests; exploratory segments never override primary disposition

practicalAcceptanceCriteria.precision: Report probabilities to no more than three decimal places in consumer guidance.

decisionRule: Potentially permissible only for the primary unrelated regular-season stratum when every sample-size, dependence, calibration and interval-width criterion passes. Unsupported timing, shared-team, postseason/tournament, sequential-incentive, common-failure and ambiguous-identity cases remain excluded regardless of aggregate results.
